query: SELECT cm.slug, cm.title, COUNT(cl.id) as lessonCount FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id ORDER BY cm.path, cm.orderIndex;
